about: The words of each mock-up's legend, 'Where each part comes from'. The legend is for the Owner's screen share, so it shows PLAIN LABELS: one per source, as `what: from` (the Advisor, 2026-09-29). The file names stay behind a switch (`files_toggle`, or the N key), with `files_note`. `sources` must name every source the mock-ups read, and no other (test P5).
title: Where each part comes from
note: Change one of these, and every piece that uses it changes.
files_note: Change one of these files and run npm run build:mockups: every piece that uses it changes. data/ and src/ are the microsite's own inputs.
